review.why: Entry point for the agent-browser CLI: drive Chrome from the command line with accessibility snapshots and element refs, then load the full guide from the CLI.
review.summary: A short discovery stub for the agent-browser CLI (Chrome over CDP, snapshot-and-ref workflow, sessions, auth vault, video). It lists the specialized guides (Electron apps, Slack, exploratory testing, HAR to API client, cloud browsers) and tells the agent to run agent-browser skills get core, so the working instructions come from the installed CLI.
strengths: Version-matched by design: the CLI serves the guide for the release you have installed.
Clear map of the specialized skills and when to use each one.
Prefers accessibility snapshots over screenshots, which keeps token use low.
cautions: The skill itself is a stub: it is only useful once the agent-browser CLI is installed (npm i -g agent-browser).
The real guide is not in this folder, so this review covers the stub only; the start of the guide was read for context.
Not run here; the frontmatter marks it hidden and tells the agent to prefer it over built-in browser tools.
